messages:
alina: Quick sync — proposing a small schema for qprofiles so Optimize can surface recommendations and we can tag rollout cohorts. Draft below.

devin: what do you mean by 'consumer signals'? can you give examples? :thinking: 

alina: consumer signals = e.g. serving route id, peeking workload (chat vs. batch), median seq len, and perf target (p99 latency budget). we can use them to filter which profiles Optimize suggests.

samir: +1. also need explicit 'fallback_compat' field so runtime can map to next-best if capacity flaps.

alina: here's a minimal manifest sample:
```
{
  "profile_id": "opt-v2-awq-256-medium",
  "model": "gpt-4o-open",
  "quant": "awq-int8",
  "ranges": {"seq_len": "<=256"},
  "workload": ["chat","embeddings"],
  "consumer_signals": {"route_tag":"nlp-chat-v2","target_p99_ms":"150"},
  "accuracy_delta": "+0.2",
  "fallback_compat": ["opt-v2-gptq-256"]
}
```

irene: slight nit: accuracy_delta should clarify metric & dataset: e.g. "+0.2@mmlu-rc" or use separate fields. also include 'eval_date' and 'baseline_model'.

alina: good call. update: add "delta_metric":"mmlu-rc","delta_value":"+0.2" and "eval_date":"2024-11-04" in final.

qprof-bot: bakeoff summary uploaded: https://internal/reports/bakeoff/1719345600 — AWQ/int8 FP8 comparisons; summary shows AWQ-int8 median perf win 1.8x and mean delta -0.4% on mmlu.

devin: with these fields Optimize can: (1) recommend profiles per route, (2) warn on delta thresholds per workspace, (3) auto-schedule canary with selected consumers. needs UI mapping for route_tag.

samir: for rollout naming let's avoid per-customer noise. recommend stable shape: <tool>-<quant>-<seq>-<tier> e.g. optimize-awq-256-medium. short + deterministic.

alina: agree. final action items:
- alina: push schema PR to qprofiles repo with samples
- irene: add delta_metric conventions doc
- samir: implement fallback_compat matching in runtime
- devin: wire route_tag in Optimize UI

devin: timeline?

alina: aiming for PR by EOD Monday and internal rollout next week. ping me for blockers.

samir: :thumbsup: I'll stub runtime matcher today.

irene: I'll draft metric conventions in the docs repo.

alina: thanks team :tada:
